proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10555 *rakṣāpuṭaka explicitly gives Gujarati rākhɔṛɔ ashes/layers of ashes. Vasavi rakhaḍo ash fits this expanded ash noun; retroflex stop versus flap and the source vowel lengths are retained. Exact survey form rakhaḍo is preserved.
